formName: Freedom of Information(FOI) Request - Request Type - General or Personal Type
formDescription: Select the FOI Request type you want to submit. General information includes records of a non-personal nature (e.g. briefing notes, contracts, agreements). Personal Type  means recorded information about an identifiable individual (e.g. health care information, correctional records, employment history).

personal.description: Personal information about yourself, a dependant child or another person
